LightningComponentBundle.description: Pure-SVG horizontal tree of the treatment area around a Property Asset (Property to Sentricon stations / mosquito-system nozzles / treatment perimeters / interior traps). Color and icon coded by Service_Line__c; Bait_Station_State__c = Heavy_Activity nodes render red. Click a node to fire a nodeselect event.

property.name: compact
property.label: Compact
property.description: Smaller node sizes for embedded use.

property.name: highlightAffectedProperties
property.label: Highlight Affected Properties
property.description: Ring downstream properties in a highlight color (used during cluster events).

property.name: serviceLine
property.label: Service Line override
property.description: Pest / Termite / Mosquito / Lawn — falls back to topology if blank.
